svg.title: Flow matching and GLASS comparison figure
svg.desc: Figure inventory: left frame contains a stochastic flow diagram with start label, sample distribution label, burgundy flow trajectories, gray dashed relations, black and burgundy nodes, blue velocity arrow and mathematical labels. Middle frame contains pretrained flow matching model text, black transform arrow, and upward statistic-to-denoiser-to-u_t arrows. Right frame contains a three-column comparison table with Flow and GLASS image pairs in three rows and prompt text; six photo areas are first constructed as SVG drafts and then replaced by confirmed SAM picture assets P001-P006.

g.desc: Origin is x_t near the center; dashed gray sample relations radiate to burgundy and black nodes. Burgundy flow curves progress from left/start or sampled points toward black terminal nodes. Velocity label and blue tangent arrow sit along the upper trajectory. The section is asymmetric but organized around the central x_t node.

The middle flow is vertically symmetric on the x≈709 axis: sufficient statistic at bottom points upward to denoiser, then upward to u_t. A horizontal black transform arrow points left from u_t toward the velocity panel.

Right table has three columns: Flow, GLASS (Ours), and Prompt. Each row is horizontally aligned with a Flow image, a GLASS image, and a two-line prompt. Confirmed SAM assets cover the six photo rectangles at their source crop positions.
g.text: a photo of a black kite
